pages.text: $(bold)Anti-Gravity$(): gravity inverted; all things fall.$(br2)$(bold)Affected Area$(): a sphere centered on yourself with a radius of 4 + Cursed Energy Output × 0.6 + Cursed Energy Affinity × 0.03 blocks, growing with your Affinity and Output.$(br2)$(bold)Forward (Technique Key C)$(): every creature within the area except the caster (and the caster's own summons) receives Levitation; each target costs one unit of cursed energy (unit = (1 - Affinity/100) × (6 + Output × 2) — the more targets, the heavier the drain, and if your cursed energy is insufficient the whole cast does not fire).

$(bold)Reversal (Reversal Key F)$(): deploys a pressure field (a toggle — it drains cursed energy every second and shuts itself off when depleted): targets inside the field endure pressure: pressure = 8 + Output × 2.4 + Affinity × 0.07.$(br2)A target's pressure threshold is computed from its body size and max health: threshold = 6 + body width × height × 8 + max health × 0.12. The larger and hardier the target, the more pressure it can take.$(li)Below the threshold: it only suffers Slowness, at a higher level (I–V) the closer it is to the threshold$(li)Above the threshold: the blocks beneath its feet (bedrock excluded) are crushed (with no drops), the target is pinned in place, and it keeps taking cursed damage while inside the field (per hit = 1.5 + excess × 0.35, applied every 0.6 seconds)$(br2)The pressure field has no effect on the caster or their own summons.
